name: Arkansas Metal Products
old_description: Call Arkansas Metal Products today for superior metal products customized to your exact specifications and requirements at a competitive cost.
about:
Arkansas Metal Products operates from Bald Knob, Arkansas, as a veteran-owned, family-operated metal fabrication shop. The company emphasizes its 40 years of collective experience, though a specific founding year is not disclosed.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication services including plasma and laser profiling, welding, tube and bar processing, forming, drilling, and crane-assisted handling. Design work is supported by AutoCAD, SigmaNEST, SketchUp, and SolidWorks. The facility also offers custom coating through its AMP Custom Coating line. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Arkansas Metal Products serves a mix of industrial clients and outdoor recreation customers. Its AMP Outdoor Outfitters line targets hunters and outdoor enthusiasts with locally made gear, while the core fabrication business works to customer specifications across various sectors.

The company states that its lean-minded staff focuses on surpassing expectations for craftsmanship and customer service, and that its quality management system addresses not only the final product but the processes used to achieve it.
built_on: Lean-minded approach to craftsmanship and service
Quality management focused on both product and process
